attribution: GeoSpec W5b split-bore fixtures: replicad sketches whose drawCircle is two sagitta arcs, extruded without a Boolean, written by replicad's blobSTEP (OCCT STEPControl_Writer).
runtimeDependency: All runtime inputs are files in this directory. The generator locator is attribution only and is never read by the test.
bytePolicy: Byte-locked assets: do not reformat, regenerate, or alter expectations. The STEP headers carry the generation timestamp, so regeneration is not byte-identical.

files.description: Washer: drawCircle(10).cut(drawCircle(4)) extruded 3. Both the exterior and the bore are split into two half-cylinder faces.
Plate 40 x 40 x 20 sketched with drawRectangle(40, 40).cut(drawCircle(5)) and extruded: a through bore r = 5 split into two half-cylinder faces.
Plate 40 x 40 x 10 with two sketched through bores r = 3 at x = -10 and x = 10, each split into two half-cylinder faces.
Plate 40 x 40 x 10 cut by drawCircle(5) centred on its x = 20 edge: two quarter-cylinder faces that open onto the side face, never a closed band.
The s1 profile extruded 10 with its top rim chamfered 1 mm: the split bore's two top arcs meet two different chamfer cones.
